title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 127
description: Ten questions on Psalms 127: unless Yahweh builds the house and watches the city, the work is in vain; children are a heritage like arrows in a mighty man's hand.

questions.text: What happens to those who build the house unless Yahweh builds it?
questions.explanation: Psalms 127:1 says "Unless Yahweh builds the house, they who build it labor in vain."

questions.text: Who guards the city in vain unless Yahweh watches over it?
questions.explanation: Psalms 127:1 says "Unless Yahweh watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain."

questions.text: Besides staying up late, what does verse 2 call vain?
questions.explanation: Psalms 127:2 says "It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late."

questions.text: Which bread is mentioned in verse 2?
questions.explanation: Psalms 127:2 speaks of "eating the bread of toil."

questions.text: What does he give to his loved ones, according to verse 2?
questions.explanation: Psalms 127:2 says "he gives sleep to his loved ones."

questions.text: What are children called in verse 3?
questions.explanation: Psalms 127:3 says "Behold, children are a heritage of Yahweh."

answers.text: A test of a father's faith

questions.text: What is the fruit of the womb called in verse 3?
questions.explanation: Psalms 127:3 says "The fruit of the womb is his reward."

questions.text: What are the children of youth like, according to verse 4?
questions.explanation: Psalms 127:4 says "As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth."

answers.text: Arrows in the hand of a mighty man
Stones in the sling of a shepherd

questions.text: What is full for the man who is called happy in verse 5?
questions.explanation: Psalms 127:5 says "Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them."

questions.text: With whom will they speak without being disappointed?
questions.explanation: Psalms 127:5 says "They won't be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate."
